description: Exploit, and measure the tail slope in the cheap direction now that margin exists. On the current tip, cut the 32 px phase from 4 to 3.5 epochs (16 fewer steps at batch 1536 with drop_last). Keep the LR triangle and Lookahead over total steps, as in E032, which added the same half-epoch. Change nothing else; no new graphs. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. E032's +0.5 epoch at 32 px bought -0.06 pp on one draw, so the tail may be saturated and a trim could be cheap.
